audit_items.title: Historical unit boundaries reject the authorised RSH-036 implementation
audit_items.acceptance: Reproduce 30 failures; repair only stale boundary assertions; retain fail-closed future guards; complete exact-head CI.

audit_items.title: Main branch protection is not applied
audit_items.acceptance: Re-read live rules; enforce exact-head required checks, PRs, no force/deletion and resolved threads; retain external blocker until administrative proof.

audit_items.title: Public repository visibility conflicts with private product policy
audit_items.acceptance: Resolve visibility using authorised settings capability and verify live; do not equate a proprietary licence with private visibility.

audit_items.title: Partial explicit freeze inventory does not prove transitive completeness
audit_items.acceptance: Generate dependency closure from entry points, dynamic imports, runtime assets and configuration; explicit exclusions and missing-edge tests; freeze exact verified source and asset hashes.
audit_items.evidence: Premature true freeze grant revoked in candidate code/manifest. Explicit inventory expanded 36 -> 41 but remains partial, not closure proof.

audit_items.title: Diagnostic summaries do not establish complete exact-source acceptance evidence
audit_items.acceptance: Retain full tree/source hashes, test details, browser/runtime/golden reports and reproducible command provenance, including failures; keep original golden PNG bytes.
audit_items.evidence: Summary now separates trigger SHA from actual checkout SHA/tree, rejects mismatched/dirty source identity and parses complete TAP totals. Ten local identity regressions pass; exact-head CI still required.

audit_items.title: Race startup failures lack bounded recovery; native failed module imports may require a page reload
audit_items.acceptance: Catch preparation/construction/readiness failures; cancel/dispose owned engines once; offer explicit page reload after module failure and same-document retry after asset/readiness failure. Prove success via real browser fault injection, without unhandled rejections or stale activation.
audit_items.diagnostic_correction: No application-level rejected-promise cache was found. Browser dynamic-module caching requires reload rather than imaginary application-cache clearing.

audit_items.title: Minimap canvas was not mounted; open-route drawing and preview could connect or wrap its endpoints
audit_items.acceptance: Mount accessible HUD canvas; preserve final open sample; close/wrap loop tracks only. Test real Ayalon and loop HUD plus unchanged golden comparison.

audit_items.title: Timed-record storage acquisition or reading can throw outside the recovery boundary
audit_items.acceptance: Inject throwing storage getter/getItem, denied storage and quota failures; return explicit structured failure, preserve bytes, retry safely and retain integrity/write-order tests.
audit_items.evidence: New regression suite: baseline 4 passed / 6 failed; repaired 10/10 pass locally. Read denial cannot overwrite previous records; failed write retries preserve queue and immutable request.

audit_items.title: PWA error caching, offline recovery and update behavior need complete acceptance
audit_items.acceptance: Do not cache non-success responses; test first/return offline visits, unavailable chunks, schema-safe upgrades, multiple tabs, rollback and stale-cache cleanup.

audit_items.title: Real-device GPU, memory and tail-latency evidence is absent
audit_items.acceptance: Instrument p50/p95/p99 and resource metrics; preserve raw samples/device/browser/quality metadata; 20-cycle, context recovery and 30-minute soak evidence. No simulated hardware claims.

audit_items.title: 125 lint warnings need risk classification rather than blanket suppression
audit_items.acceptance: Inventory exact rule/path counts; prioritise hook lifecycle and unused critical-path code; fix in appropriate units with zero newly introduced warnings and no rule disabling.

audit_items.title: 66 asset files remain unverified for use and distribution
audit_items.acceptance: For each asset record source, owner, permission/licence and proof; replace or remove uncleared material. Inventory coverage is not clearance; keep release gate closed.

audit_items.title: Catalogue breadth must not substitute for the eight verified V1 tracks
audit_items.acceptance: Preserve canonical eight MVP IDs and 48 deferred tracks; each added V1 track gets geometry/driving and art/golden/freeze acceptance after Ayalon.

audit_items.title: Current state, future projections and historical approvals are conflated
audit_items.acceptance: Record actual merged acceptance only; separate in-review and authorised-not-activated work; harmonise JSON, master plan, NEXT and evidence; preserve history.

audit_items.title: Earlier r6 proposal misassigned canonical unit titles, V1 tracks and legacy finding IDs
audit_items.acceptance: Rebuild mappings from live canonical 67-unit plan, track classification and 42-row findings register; retain earlier report as non-authoritative; add negative mapping tests.

audit_items.title: Copied hard-coded phase fences cause recurrent transition failures
audit_items.acceptance: Add central execution invariants and all-future-unit negative tests now; replace duplicated live activation fences in a separately tested transition layer while preserving historical reconstruction hashes.

audit_items.title: Partial texture-batch failure and constructor interruption need explicit resource-ownership recovery proof
audit_items.acceptance: Inject failure after some road textures load; verify fulfilled textures are released or safely retained, rejected in-flight entries are evicted, concurrent loads do not duplicate ownership, and partially constructed engines cannot leak resources. Preserve healthy visual output.
audit_items.evidence: src/game/road-assets.ts uses Promise.all before kits.set; partial success lifetime is not covered by the current ownership tests. This is not yet a reproduced browser leak.

legacy_findings.finding: Repository visibility conflicts with the private-code statement
legacy_findings.evidence: GitHub still reports public visibility. RSH-012 establishes an explicit proprietary licence but does not change repository visibility.
legacy_findings.remediation: Owner changes visibility to private; live re-verification

legacy_findings.finding: `main` is not protected
legacy_findings.evidence: GitHub reports `protected=false`, required checks 0 and rulesets 0. RSH-008 records the desired ruleset, but no administrative mutation has been applied.

legacy_findings.finding: No branch-and-PR delivery workflow exists
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-001–RSH-013 use isolated branches and PRs; governance, CODEOWNERS and templates are versioned. Live settings enforcement remains absent.

legacy_findings.finding: No GitHub Actions CI is present
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-007 merged `required-ci / validate`; exact-head CI remains the acceptance authority.

legacy_findings.finding: The QA command is not self-contained
legacy_findings.evidence: The RSH-006 harness starts, validates and stops its own server in CI.

legacy_findings.finding: Automation contains absolute `/workspace` paths
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-005 migrated executable automation to module-relative roots; `check:paths` prevents recurrence.

legacy_findings.finding: Secret scanning is too narrow
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-024 scans tracked text under `src/`, `scripts/`, `server/` and `.github/` with eight fail-closed patterns instead of only `src/game`.

legacy_findings.finding: Operational contracts are ignored by Git
legacy_findings.evidence: Governance, contribution, security, toolchain, QA, CI, product and metadata contracts are versioned; ignored AGENTS/startup files still require a decision.

legacy_findings.finding: Program status sources contradict one another
legacy_findings.evidence: Canonical state, queue, master plan and NEXT authority are merged; historical files are explicitly non-controlling.

legacy_findings.finding: The last audit is stale and sequencing rules were violated
legacy_findings.evidence: The queue was reset, product scope was frozen, all 56 tracks were classified and asset/metadata authorities were established; vertical-slice enforcement remains pending.

legacy_findings.finding: No version, tag, release or rollback baseline exists
legacy_findings.evidence: Immutable baseline, milestone, label and release registers exist; tags, releases and rollback proof remain absent.

legacy_findings.finding: Root licensing and asset provenance are incomplete
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-011 inventories 134/134 public files; RSH-012 establishes the proprietary root licence. Exactly 66 asset files remain unverified and uncleared.
legacy_findings.remediation: Replace or document every unverified asset; keep public distribution blocked

legacy_findings.finding: Production QA-hook removal is not enforced by GitHub
legacy_findings.evidence: `check:qa` passes inside the required workflow, but GitHub does not yet require that check through branch settings.
legacy_findings.remediation: Apply the RSH-008 desired ruleset; RSH-024 hardening

legacy_findings.finding: Timed-record hashes are generated but not verified on read
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-023 verifies SHA-256 record hashes on every load, drops stale physics versions and structurally invalid rows, and bounds storage to 24 per track/car plus 200 overall.

legacy_findings.finding: Timed-record writes are fire-and-forget
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-023 serialises persist through one in-module chain, replaces `rush.records.v3` with canonical JSON, verifies the write, and returns structured duplicate/rejected/write-failed status without deleting source bytes.

legacy_findings.finding: Save failures and corruption are silently swallowed
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-021 establishes deterministic schema/version handling. RSH-022 adds verified backup rotation, bounded exact-byte quarantine, explicit restore/fresh-start decisions, structured failures and accessible bilingual failure UI without deleting source or legacy bytes.

legacy_findings.finding: The build command performs database migration
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-020 removes the DB subsystem and migration scripts; `npm run build` is exactly `vite build`.

legacy_findings.finding: Template auth, DB, multiplayer and Grok infrastructure is not product-scoped
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-020 removes auth, DB, migrations, multiplayer, app-env and preview-host bridges. The retained `/__grok/*` PWA URLs are explicitly product-owned compatibility paths.

legacy_findings.finding: The dependency set is broader than the observed product surface
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-020 reduces direct packages from 74 to 30: 10 runtime and 20 development packages; 44 unused direct packages are removed.

legacy_findings.finding: Package identity and runtime requirements are undefined
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-004 fixes Node 22.16.0/npm 10.9.2; RSH-012 fixes product name, version `0.0.0-private`, private package status and `UNLICENSED` boundary.

legacy_findings.finding: The toolchain cannot be reproduced exactly
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-007 clean checkout verified the pinned Node/npm toolchain and `npm ci`.

legacy_findings.finding: Lint is not part of the required validation gate
legacy_findings.evidence: `required-ci / validate` executes blocking ESLint.

legacy_findings.finding: The complete test suite is not part of the required validation gate
legacy_findings.evidence: `required-ci / validate` executes complete `npm test`.

legacy_findings.finding: Important validation scripts are outside the main gate
legacy_findings.evidence: Golden, damage, Ayalon lock, HaShalom and long-soak checks are not all required on every PR.
legacy_findings.remediation: RSH-035, RSH-042 and later CI expansion

legacy_findings.finding: No accepted real-device performance baseline exists
legacy_findings.evidence: No verified desktop/mobile p95, memory or draw-call evidence exists.

legacy_findings.finding: Core source files are excessively large
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-014–RSH-017 establish track, world and engine boundaries. RSH-018 reduces `game-app.tsx` from 1540 to 179 lines and moves screens, HUD and race control into three manifest-bound modules with byte-exact reconstruction.

legacy_findings.finding: Content, rendering, physics, UI and QA are tightly coupled
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-013–RSH-019 establish track, world, engine, UI and resource boundaries. RSH-020 removes unused template subsystems and pins the final direct dependency surface.

legacy_findings.finding: Catalogue breadth precedes a verified vertical slice
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-010 classifies 8 MVP and 48 deferred tracks, but no track has an owner-approved release freeze.

legacy_findings.finding: Golden evidence does not yet form a trusted acceptance authority
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-035 records owner approval of the 20 unique Ayalon/HaShalom frames and keeps the four duplicate placeholders non-authority. Ayalon freeze and transitive-dependency hashes remain RSH-036.

legacy_findings.finding: `EXECUTION_PLAN.md` is an operational monolith
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-001 removed it from queue authority, but the historic monolith remains.

legacy_findings.finding: Product metadata references Israel and New York
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-012 aligns the root title, description, package metadata, Open Graph and both PWA runtime paths to the frozen Israel-inspired private product.

legacy_findings.finding: CODEOWNERS and contribution templates are absent
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-002 merged CODEOWNERS, a PR template, contribution policy and governance contract.

legacy_findings.finding: Commit-signing policy is not enforced
legacy_findings.evidence: Recent GitHub merge commits are verified, but historical commits and future enforcement are not governed by a required rule.

legacy_findings.finding: Commit cadence and direct-main history reduce reviewability
legacy_findings.evidence: New work uses PRs, but historical rapid direct-main changes remain and technical settings enforcement is pending.

legacy_findings.finding: No changelog or architecture-decision register exists
legacy_findings.evidence: Baseline and release registers exist, but no changelog or ADR register exists.

legacy_findings.finding: No dependency-update policy exists
legacy_findings.evidence: `DEPENDENCY-POLICY.md` defines lockfile authority, monthly/release review, isolated updates, exact-head validation and serial-queue restrictions.

legacy_findings.finding: A beta Nitro version is on the build path
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-020 records npm registry evidence that `3.0.260610-beta` is the `latest` dist-tag, retains an exact pin and requires full validation for replacement.

legacy_findings.finding: README does not document reproducible setup and validation
legacy_findings.evidence: RSH-012 documents exact Node/npm versions, `npm ci`, development, full tests, self-starting QA and deterministic build commands.

legacy_findings.finding: No bundle or asset budget is enforced
legacy_findings.evidence: No accepted size threshold or CI budget exists.

legacy_findings.finding: Touch-action behaviour is not explicitly locked
legacy_findings.evidence: Pointer cancellation exists, but browser gesture suppression is not a verified contract.

legacy_findings.finding: Crash reporting, telemetry and privacy policy are undefined
legacy_findings.evidence: No accepted collection and retention policy exists.

legacy_findings.finding: No browser and device support matrix exists
legacy_findings.evidence: Supported Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and mobile versions are undefined.

Pre-freeze runtime loading, minimap and records repairs
Complete failure evidence and warning classification

counting_rule: Audit items and legacy findings overlap; they are not additive bug counts. Bundles supplement original units and do not inflate accepted-unit progress.
acceptance_rule: Only validated merged work is accepted. A standing grant permits serial execution, not bypassing predecessor, tests, evidence or release gates.
limitations: Exact baseline tree c74b50f2795c8a87e71fa650aac99969dc2a0672 reconstructed from the CI source archive; all 693 source files match the verified live head. This is not manual line-by-line review of all code.

Local complete suite: 567 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped using Node 22.16.0 and locally available TypeScript 5.8.3. Locked dependency installation, browser validation and new remote CI remain required.
Native module failure recovery and actual minimap mounting have browser fault-injection tests committed but not yet claimed as passed at this preparation checkpoint.
Full dependency closure, partial texture-batch ownership, real-device performance, exact golden/freeze acceptance and release clearance remain incomplete.
No accepted unit count, golden PNG, lock generation, physics, track data, package dependency, asset licence or public distribution permission is changed.
